The animal has coarse, grey-brown fur, a large bare nose, small dark eyes, and rounded ears partially obscured by vegetation. The focus is sharp on the face, with the background and foreground grass slightly blurred.

To verify that the out-of-focus grass blades in the foreground have consistent depth blur relative to the sharp face, checking for spatial grounding errors.
